title: Demo project 2 — Featured, extend cover, no highlight
summary: A featured placeholder project without a highlight, so the feed falls back to this summary and the cover. Its body shows asides at every side and size, ready to reorder or reframe with Arrange.

image.alt: Placeholder cover: a rounded shape centred on a flat grey background.

content.text: Try Edit body → Arrange to drag these blocks into a new order, or press New frame on a bubble to give it a new pebble shape. Asides (bubbles) sit beside the text on the left or right, or between paragraphs in the centre. They come in five sizes, xs to xl, and hold images, text, quotes, or stats.
